signals.signal: CEC Bank is hiring an 'Ofiter bancar - Administrare Numerar Automate Bancare' (banking officer, ATM cash administration) in Directia Operatiuni, Bucharest, application deadline 09/08/2026. The posting describes an entirely MANUAL ATM cash-forecasting process: analysing balance files received from the Cards Department, checking average daily withdrawals per terminal, hand-picking which ATM/MFM (multi-function machine, i.e. deposit-capable ATM) terminals need replenishment, allocating terminals per cash-point to each external CIT provider, computing the denomination mix for the next two days, and reconciling provider reports into the Qbank application. CEC Bank total live vacancies on its Mingle portal on 31/07/2026: 30.
signals.source_name: CEC Bank careers portal (Mingle ATS, embedded at cec.ro/cariere)
signals.implies: Textbook NCR APTRA OptiCash cash-optimisation opportunity: CEC is doing denomination-level cash forecasting and CIT order management by hand off spreadsheets. Also opens ATM/device telemetry and monitoring, and cash recyclers (Glory/Sesami TCR, NCR) to cut CIT trips. The 'MFM' fleet reference confirms deposit-capable estate already in place.
signals.likelihood: High that CEC continues ATM/MFM estate work through 2026-2027 given the parallel Agentia Digitala self-service branch programme
signals.followup: Ask CEC Directia Operatiuni / Directia Carduri whether cash forecasting is in scope for automation; position OptiCash + telemetry against the manual Qbank process. Deadline 09/08/2026 signals imminent team build.
